name: Creative Writing
description: This course introduces students to the fundamentals of fiction and script writing, blending creative expression with structural techniques to enhance storytelling and communication. Through diverse texts—poetry, flash fiction, comics, and scripts—students explore narrative elements like plot, character, and dialogue. Activities such as group brainstorming, improvisation, and peer review foster critical and creative thinking. Weekly tasks focus on drafting, revising, and presenting, culminating in collaborative writing projects. By analyzing real-world content and experimenting with genre and form, students develop a nuanced understanding of language, tone, and audience—building confidence in their ability to craft compelling stories across formats and disciplines.
